# King Fisher browser vendor files

These files are unmodified web UMD artifacts supplied for the F10 client integration:

- `bridge-0.6.0.umd.js`: `@king-fisher/bridge` 0.6.0
- `falcon-0.5.26-zcp-692-snapshot.umd.js`: `@king-fisher/falcon` 0.5.26-zcp-692-snapshot

Both source packages declare the ISC license. The standalone product packager embeds the scripts as inert strings and the F10 host adapter injects them only when an F10 capability is requested.
